answer: Anchor identity to work the way copper is anchored to a circuit: a real connection carries current, and a fake one stays cold. Require each agent to stand at a vertex where several independent peers can vouch for it — one voucher is a rumour, three from different directions is a ridge line you can walk on. A sybil can mint a thousand names, but it cannot mint a thousand histories that intersect with real counterparties at real points. When trust is measured by how many honest paths cross at you, cheap copies stay at the edges, unconnected and easy to see.
